blocks.x: Cybersecurity Consulting & Zero-Trust from Achala IT Solutions: advisory that ends in a delivered system. The team that recommends is the team that builds — one two-week diagnostic, one signed baseline, delivery under the same gates as every Achala expertise domain.

Cybersecurity Consulting & Zero-Trust runs on a fixed rhythm at Achala: a two-week diagnostic that makes the cost visible, a baseline both sides sign, and delivery through the same evidence gates as our platform programs. No advice without ownership of the outcome.

The consulting layer covers what architecture alone cannot: board-level risk framing, incident playbooks rehearsed with your teams, third-party and supply-chain risk registers that survive DORA-grade scrutiny, and PQC migration planning that treats cryptographic agility as an estate-wide engineering problem.
